description: Flat patient-level metadata schema for a pediatric brain tumor radiotherapy registry capturing demographics, tumor characteristics, treatment details, toxicities, interventions, and outcomes.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual registry record or patient episode; must be stable within the registry.

patient_id.descr: De-identified patient identifier used to link longitudinal records for the same child across visits or treatment episodes.

site_id.descr: Registry site or participating center identifier where the record was created.

country.descr: Country where the patient was treated or registered; use standardized country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3 code.

birth_date.descr: Patient date of birth in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sex_at_birth.descr: Sex assigned at birth; expected values such as female, male, intersex, or unknown.

race_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or registry-coded race/ethnicity category; use controlled vocabulary if available.

age_at_diagnosis_years.descr: Age at initial tumor diagnosis in years; may include decimals for months (e.g., 4.5).

age_at_radiotherapy_start_years.descr: Age at first radiotherapy fraction in years; may include decimals.

weight_kg.descr: Body weight at baseline or radiotherapy start in kilograms (kg).

height_cm.descr: Body height at baseline or radiotherapy start in centimeters (cm).

body_surface_area_m2.descr: Body surface area at baseline or radiotherapy start in square meters (m^2).

performance_status.descr: Baseline functional/performance status score or category, such as Lansky or Karnofsky; specify the scale used in accompanying documentation.

comorbidities.descr: Relevant baseline medical history or comorbid conditions affecting treatment tolerance, recorded as a standardized text or coded list.

neurological_deficits_at_baseline.descr: Pre-treatment neurological findings such as weakness, cranial nerve palsy, ataxia, seizures, or hydrocephalus.

prior_surgery.descr: Whether the patient had tumor-directed surgery before radiotherapy.

surgery_type.descr: Type of prior surgery, such as biopsy, subtotal resection, or gross total resection; use if prior_surgery is true.

surgery_date.descr: Date of the most recent tumor-directed surgery before radiotherapy, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

histology.descr: Tumor histologic diagnosis, such as medulloblastoma, ependymoma, or diffuse midline glioma.

molecular_classification.descr: Molecular subtype or biomarker classification, such as SHH, WNT, Group 3, H3K27-altered, or other relevant molecular label.

tumor_grade.descr: Histologic grade or equivalent tumor grade classification, if applicable.

tumor_location.descr: Primary anatomic tumor location in the brain, such as cerebellum, brainstem, supratentorial, or ventricular system.

tumor_laterality.descr: Tumor laterality when relevant; expected values such as left, right, midline, bilateral, or not_applicable.

metastatic_status.descr: Presence of metastatic disease at diagnosis or before radiotherapy; expected values such as M0, M1, M2, M3, or unknown.

staging_system.descr: Staging framework used for the tumor, such as Chang, AJCC, or other disease-specific system.

radiotherapy_intent.descr: Clinical intent of radiotherapy, such as curative, adjuvant, definitive, salvage, or palliative.

radiotherapy_modality.descr: Radiation delivery modality, such as photon, proton, carbon ion, stereotactic radiosurgery, or whole-brain radiation.

radiotherapy_technique.descr: Delivery technique, such as 3D conformal RT, IMRT, VMAT, craniospinal irradiation, or stereotactic technique.

radiotherapy_site_targeted.descr: Anatomic target treated, such as primary tumor bed, whole brain, craniospinal axis, boost volume, or metastatic site.

radiation_energy_MeV_or_MV.descr: Nominal beam energy used for treatment, reported in MeV or MV depending on modality.

planned_total_dose_Gy.descr: Planned total prescribed radiation dose in Gray (Gy) for the course of radiotherapy.

delivered_total_dose_Gy.descr: Actual cumulative dose delivered in Gray (Gy), accounting for interruptions or modifications.

dose_per_fraction_Gy.descr: Dose per treatment fraction in Gray (Gy).

number_of_fractions_planned.descr: Planned total number of treatment fractions for the course of radiotherapy.

fractionation_schedule.descr: Fractionation pattern description, such as once daily, twice daily, hyperfractionated, or hypofractionated.

treatment_start_date.descr: Date of first radiotherapy fraction in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

treatment_end_date.descr: Date of last radiotherapy fraction in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

treatment_duration_days.descr: Total elapsed calendar days from first to last fraction of radiotherapy.

overall_treatment_time_days.descr: Elapsed time from planned start to completion, including interruptions if applicable.

treatment_interruption.descr: Whether the radiotherapy course experienced any interruption, delay, or unplanned break.

modification_made_during_therapy.descr: Whether any treatment modification occurred during the radiotherapy course.

modification_type.descr: Type of modification, such as dose reduction, replanning, field adjustment, schedule delay, or boost change.

modification_reason.descr: Reason for the treatment modification, such as toxicity, disease progression, technical issue, or patient intolerance.

concurrent_chemotherapy.descr: Whether chemotherapy was administered during radiotherapy.

concurrent_systemic_agents.descr: Names of concurrent systemic agents given during radiotherapy, if any.

prior_chemotherapy.descr: Whether the patient received chemotherapy before radiotherapy.

post_radiotherapy_systemic_therapy.descr: Any systemic therapy given after radiotherapy, if relevant to outcome interpretation.

supportive_care_medications.descr: Relevant supportive medications during treatment, such as steroids, antiemetics, or anticonvulsants.

treatment_related_side_effects.descr: Observed radiotherapy-related adverse effects; may include acute and early delayed toxicities.

toxicity_grading_system.descr: System used to grade adverse events, such as CTCAE, RTOG, or institutional grading.

max_toxicity_grade.descr: Highest adverse event grade observed during or after radiotherapy according to the stated grading system.

neurologic_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any neurological adverse effect was observed during or after radiotherapy.

specific_neurologic_toxicity.descr: Specific neurological toxicity such as headache, seizures, cognitive decline, neuropathy, ataxia, or hearing loss.

hematologic_toxicity_present.descr: Whether clinically relevant hematologic toxicity occurred during treatment.

other_organ_toxicity.descr: Non-neurologic, non-hematologic adverse effects such as skin reaction, mucositis, nausea, or endocrine effects.

intervention_required_for_toxicity.descr: Whether an additional intervention was required to manage side effects.

toxicity_intervention.descr: Intervention used to manage toxicity, such as corticosteroids, hospitalization, anticonvulsants, dose hold, or surgery.

toxicity_intervention_date.descr: Date when the toxicity-related intervention was initiated, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

hospitalization_due_to_toxicity.descr: Whether the patient was hospitalized because of treatment-related toxicity.

radiotherapy_completion_status.descr: Whether the planned radiotherapy course was completed, partially completed, or discontinued.

reason_not_completed.descr: Reason radiotherapy was not completed, if applicable, such as progression, toxicity, death, or withdrawal.

tumor_response_best.descr: Best observed tumor response after radiotherapy, such as complete response, partial response, stable disease, progressive disease, or not_evaluable.

response_assessment_date.descr: Date of the best response assessment in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

follow_up_duration_months.descr: Length of follow-up from radiotherapy start or end, specified by registry convention, in months.

tumor_control_status.descr: Current disease control status, such as controlled, recurrent, progressive, or unknown.

recurrence_or_progression.descr: Whether tumor recurrence or progression occurred after radiotherapy.

recurrence_date.descr: Date of first documented recurrence or progression, if applicable, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

neurological_outcome.descr: Post-treatment neurological outcome category, such as improved, unchanged, worsened, or unknown.

cognitive_outcome.descr: Cognitive outcome or neurocognitive status after therapy, if assessed.

endocrine_sequelae.descr: Endocrine late effects or pituitary-related sequelae observed after treatment.

hearing_outcome.descr: Hearing status after treatment, such as normal, mild loss, moderate loss, severe loss, or cochlear implant.

survival_status.descr: Vital status at last follow-up; expected values such as alive, deceased, or lost_to_follow_up.

death_date.descr: Date of death if applicable, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

cause_of_death.descr: Primary cause of death, if known, such as tumor progression, treatment toxicity, infection, or other cause.

last_follow_up_date.descr: Date of the most recent follow-up contact or assessment in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
